answer: Open entry without making Sybils free. First, newcomers lock a refundable 10 POA bond. Second, two random established peers inspect signed activity and attest separately. Third, release the bond after two useful epochs; reward peers only for accepted work. Fourth, linked control signals trigger review; proven duplicates forfeit the bond and sit out a season. A 500-account farm locks 5,000 POA and pays 30 POA for 1,500 attestations at 0.02 each. Dawn reveals repeats, pigment marks each history, and quartz keeps the record firm—a lighthouse turning impostors into shadows before shore.
